searchText: Four blocks until London on Rinkeby! London is live on Rinkeby :pog: hmmm Nethermind nodes stayed on the transition block is etherscan on London branch? ah no, we seem fine too Can someone send a 1559-style txn to make sure 😅 I can try if no one has a script handy https://rinkeby.etherscan.io/tx/0x6a2e349c6c98ff0ace3426d939747dcce4f19abc34cc4599ff847dbf3eceaf6e Lgtm! Just a heads up that we're seeing some weird things on Rinkeby Lots and lots of txs are piled up but are not mined Figured it out, it's a "transition" issue. Our miners accepted 1gwei txs. When London passed, the 1gwei "total" became `1gwei - eps` tip, which was less than the miner wants, but we don't have an eviction in place for this transition So the 1gwei-7wei basefee txs remained in the pool but were rejected by the miner, everything afterwards piling up One suggestion I have: we at EthereumJS are always very thankful for some lightweight test network where it's easy to connect to without the hazzle of a long sync, I could imagine that this is also the case for various teams/devs within the ecosystem (unproven though, might be a case for a question by <@!420951281910284289>). Would it be a way to just always keep the last ephemeral network set up (in this case: `calaveras`) until the next HF (and then replace by the last `shanghai` network and so on) and somewhat better document that and add this as an additional test network layer in addition to the existing heavier weight networks? This *will* come with some extra administration effort, but I would assume this could be valuable to the community. We now have got our **final EthereumJS London releases** (VM, Tx, other) out including the finalized block numbers: https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/releases We could, but isn't one of the challenges that the network will start taking a while to sync to if we leave it on too long 😅 ? **AllCoreDevs in ~23h (July 9, 14:00 UTC)** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/342 Stream: https://youtu.be/OLCumSVoc0o Zoom: to be shared here before the call <@552133098075193354> for a let's say a HF to HF period of three months block numbers would go up to numbers of ~500.000, that would still be in another league (factor 10x) than even the youngest major test network Goerli with its 5Mio+ blocks. If we do a HF every 3 months then I'm out 😄 https://twitter.com/wolflo0/status/1413235451654070273?s=20
